title: Clawd X Digest
summary: xAI Grok Voice: xAI launched Voice Agent Builder, a no-code platform to build human-like voice agents at $0.05/min.
Google Gemini Free Tier: Google quietly enabled free-tier access for Gemini 3.5 Flash, offering a 1M token context window and 1,500 free requests per day.
Developer Tools Crackdown: Major tech enterprises are restricting internal usage of AI coding tools like Claude Code and Codex due to IP concerns.
YSJF Tim Censored: Renowned Chinese tech creator Tim from YSJF (影视飓风) was unexpectedly blocked across all major platforms.
SEC Reporting Rule: Public feedback is open on proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which critics warn could allow corporations to delay reporting poor earnings for six months.

items.title: @xai: Voice Agent Builder Launch
items.body: xAI has introduced Voice Agent Builder, a no-code platform to create human-like voice agents using Grok Voice, priced at $0.05 per minute.

items.title: @Etudecn: Building Personal AI Agents
items.body: Highlights an Anthropic engineer's 45-minute step-by-step tutorial on dismantling manual tasks and configuring custom AI assistants to automate daily workflows.

items.title: @baoshu88: Corporate Bans on AI Coding Tools
items.body: Reports that multiple large tech companies are starting to ban AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex internally to protect intellectual property.

items.title: @CDGalpha: Gemini 3.5 Flash Free Tier Availability
items.body: Google has quietly made its latest Gemini 3.5 Flash model available on the free tier, offering a 1M token context window, 1,500 requests per day, and native multimodal support without a credit card.

items.title: @GergelyOrosz: AI Talent Exodus from Apple
items.body: Relays a former Apple engineer's experience leaving the company for an AI infrastructure startup due to the difficulty of transferring internally to Apple's AI-focused teams.

items.title: @ma_zhenyuan: Learning AI Agents with Open Deep Research
items.body: Recommends studying the LangChain team's open-deep-research codebase as a definitive resource for understanding how to build advanced AI agents.

items.title: @keepitquarterly: SEC Proposal on Semiannual Reporting
items.body: Warns about SEC Rule S7-2026-15, a proposed regulation that would allow public companies to delay reporting poor financial results for up to six months, raising concerns about insider selling.

items.title: @qaq5777: YSJF Tim Blocked Across Chinese Platforms
items.body: Reports the sudden, sweeping censorship and blocking of popular tech content creator Tim (影视飓风) and his associate Li Siwei across Chinese social media platforms.

items.title: @0xKevin00: Hedging SK Hynix with OTM Puts
items.body: Details a practical case study of using Out-of-the-Money (OTM) put options to hedge a 13.6% three-day drop in SK Hynix stock, mitigating portfolio drawdowns by several percentage points.

items.title: @xianzhe9527: Personal Finance & Permanent Portfolios
items.body: Assesses the wealth comparison of having 350,000 RMB ($50,000 USD) yielding a steady return via a permanent portfolio compared to general monthly income statistics in China.

items.title: @FoxNews: Bruce Blakeman's NY Gubernatorial Agenda
items.body: NY Republican gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman outlines his core policies, including ending sanctuary policies, lowering energy costs, and cutting taxes.

items.title: @TheBestqueenx: Laser Pointer User Caught in 4K
items.body: A viral video capturing a stadium spectator using a laser pointer being caught red-handed in high definition by professional broadcasting cameras.

items.title: @mamashami2: World Cup VAR Decisions Under Fire
items.body: Criticizes FIFA's video assistant referee (VAR) implementation, calling the tournament an elimination process driven by VAR decisions rather than standard football.

items.title: @NotFarLeftAtAll: David Beckham Queuing in Public
items.body: Highlights the moment David Beckham chose to queue for 12 hours with the general public to view Queen Elizabeth II lying in state in 2022, eschewing the VIP fast-track option.

items.title: @suanrongyouyuxu: Zootopia as a Metaphor for DEI
items.body: A lengthy analysis of how Disney's Zootopia serves as a powerful, non-confrontational allegory for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) by bypassing political defensive mechanisms through animal characters.

items.title: @cuichenghao: Extreme Remote Work Culture
items.body: Shows a viral video of a Chinese worker forced to participate in an emergency video call with their manager while sitting on a fast-moving amusement park ride.
